This lesson covers Virtues in Islam • Modesty • Contentment • Trustworthiness, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:

● Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening and speaking are enhanced as learners discuss the

Islamic teachings on modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in groups and make class presentations.
